summary: I do not think @aaronpk has added offline support yet but I see him studying @adacito's recent work on offline service workers so a "save for later" or "download feeds" might someday happen. For now you can use indiepaper.io https://www.indiepaper.io/
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I do not think @aaronpk has added offline support yet but I see him studying @adacito's recent work on offline service workers so a "save for later" or "download feeds" might someday happen. For now you can use indiepaper.io https://www.indiepaper.io/
